    Overview

    Enhance Claude Code with export, navigation, and two-click AI plan analysis.

    Boost your productivity on Claude Code with powerful features designed for developers working with long and complex chats. 🚀 Features 📄 Export Chat to Markdown Download full conversations as clean .md files Perfect for documentation, sharing, or saving your work Keeps structure readable and developer-friendly 📑 Table of Contents for Easy Navigation Automatically generates a table of contents for each chat Jump between messages instantly Makes long discussions manageable 🧠 Smart Plan Extraction Detects when Claude generates a structured plan Export the plan as a .md file or copy it to clipboard Saves time when working with task breakdowns ⚡ Quick Prompt Templates 1. Save prompts you use frequently, such as code reviews, test generation, documentation, refactoring, or bug analysis 2. Insert any saved prompt into the current chat with a single click 3. Eliminate repetitive typing and keep your workflow consistent 🔄 One-Click AI Review Instantly send extracted plans to: ChatGPT Gemini Perplexity Compare outputs and improve decision-making Great for validation and second opinions 💡 Why use this extension? Working in Claude Code often involves long chats, detailed plans, and iterative problem solving. This extension helps you: Stay organized Navigate faster Reuse and validate ideas across multiple AI tools Turn conversations into reusable documentation 👨‍💻 Built for developers Whether you're debugging, planning architecture, or generating content — this extension turns Claude Code into a more powerful workflow tool.
